title: validation_report
description: EchoForge validation_report document. Records the outcome of a validation run against a specific subject document (any of the other 11 EchoForge kinds), including individual check results and an overall pass/warn/fail status. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic ids, explicit provenance, license, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1, computed from the identity field tuple.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; must be the literal string "validation_report".

schema_version.description: Schema contract version this document conforms to (currently pinned to 1.0.0).

public_proxy_id.description: Slug identifying the public proxy this validation report is associated with (lowercase, dot/underscore/hyphen separated).

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: source kind, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) governing use of this document.

validation.description: Validation envelope of the report document itself: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and per-check results.

report_name.description: Human-readable name of the validation report (e.g. "object_card_geometry_audit_2026q2"); non-empty string.

subject_kind.description: Kind discriminator of the subject document under validation; one of the other 11 EchoForge kinds (object_card, material_card, mesh_manifest, solver_card, rcs_campaign, echosig_manifest, sensor_archetype, scenario, radar_episode, detector_graph, dataset_card).

subject_id.description: Deterministic id of the subject document this report describes.

checks.description: Individual validation check results that make up this report; at least one check required.

overall_status.description: Aggregate verdict across all checks: "pass" (all green), "warn" (non-fatal issues), or "fail" (one or more fatal issues).
